description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table which manages validation rules for HTML table child elements, handling the structure and order of table-related tags in the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table
classes.description: A class representing a child element definition for HTML tables, validating the correct structure of table elements according to HTML specifications.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes the child nodes of a table to ensure they conform to HTML table structure rules, wrapping stray tr elements in tbody if in tbody mode.
